scope: independent mathematical references; no HEAR/CFX device execution
representation: BFP exponent E is total right shifts. Compare FFT raw*2^E against X; vMag raw*2^(E+1) against magnitude because vMag 2.22 versus input 1.23. Word0/1 packs DC/Nyquist.

tolerance.basis: Predeclared engineering checks for 24-bit window/twiddle rounding and table-lookup sqrt, sufficient to reject omitted Hann or factor-two scale errors. SDK describes representation/approximation but does NOT publish these accuracy bounds; these are not manufacturer guarantees and need target validation before report PASS.
